_doc: Context for translators: what each key is and where it appears. {braces} are placeholders and must stay.
site.name: Site-wide: header, footer, page titles. The site's full name; header and every page title. Keep in English or transliterate, your call; use the same form everywhere
hub.h1: Home page and the per-coin pages (/en/, /en/assets/…). Main heading. The coin picker sits where {asset} is, so the words before and after it must work around it
hub.time: Home page and the per-coin pages (/en/, /en/assets/…). Table column: how long until an exchange credits the deposit
wallet_vs_exchange.title: "The two fees" box on the home page. Box heading. The box explains the difference between a network fee and an exchange withdrawal fee; users confuse these
calc.from: Calculator page. Calculator field: where the money is sent from (own wallet, or an exchange)
case.existing_recipient: Network pages: "other cases" box and home page case cards. Fee when the recipient has received this token before (cheaper)
case.new_recipient: Network pages: "other cases" box and home page case cards. Fee when the recipient has never held this token (more expensive on Tron and Solana)
ex.unverified: Exchange pages (/en/exchanges/…). Pill shown until a fact has been checked against the source
method.saudi_text: How it works page (/en/methodology/). Regulatory note for Saudi readers. Keep the wording cautious and factual; SAMA and CMA are the regulators' names
widget.credit: Inside the embeddable widgets (iframes on other sites). Small credit line inside the widget; {site} is the site name, linked
wallet_vs_exchange.wallet_lead: "The two fees" box on the home page. Bold lead-in of the first line, ends with a colon
wallet_vs_exchange.exchange_lead: "The two fees" box on the home page. Bold lead-in of the second line, ends with a colon
ex.network_fee: Exchange pages (/en/exchanges/…). Table cell for an exchange that charges no fixed fee but passes the live network fee through (BitOasis)
history.by_network: History pages (/en/history/…). Heading above the grid of 30-day charts
method.how.*: Methodology table, one plain-English sentence or two per network on how its live fee is calculated. Keep technical terms (gas, base fee, tip, rent, confirmations) consistent across rows.
method.fee_page: How it works page (/en/methodology/). Link word after the exchange name: 'Binance fee page'
nav.top: Main menu (header). Accessible label of the round green button that scrolls back to the top
embed.code_label: Free embed page (/en/embed/). Screen-reader label of the code boxes
method.description: How it works page (/en/methodology/). Search-engine description of the methodology page
embed.description: Free embed page (/en/embed/). Search-engine description of the embed page
calc.description: Calculator page. Search-engine description of the calculator page
compare.description: Compare pages (/en/compare/…). Search-engine description of the compare pages
hub.description: Home page and the per-coin pages (/en/, /en/assets/…). Search-engine description of the home page and coin pages
history.description: History pages (/en/history/…). Search-engine description of the history pages
site.tagline: Site-wide: header, footer, page titles. Used in the site's structured data (search engines), not visible on the page
site.footer_project: Site-wide: header, footer, page titles. Footer, last line. 'Gulf Arcade' is the brand name: keep in English
site.footer_note: Site-wide: header, footer, page titles. Footer disclaimer, every page. Legal tone
nav.home: Main menu (header). Menu item for the home page (live fees)
nav.methodology: Main menu (header). Menu item for the methodology page; the English is deliberately plain ('How it works')
nav.embed: Main menu (header). Menu item, shown as a green pill; 'embed' = put the widget on your own site
updated: 'Updated {time}': {time} is a date and time, keep the placeholder.
observed_at: 'observed {time}' after a number: when it was read.
stale: Warning when a live source is down: the last good value is shown with its time.
source: Link word next to a licence or a figure.
